text: Bus frequency level service (LOS) classification methodology used evaluate quality bus services based frequency. classification based Highway Capacity Manual (HCM) 2000 guidelines “Service Frequency LOS Urban Scheduled Transit Service” (Exhibit 27-1), implemented GTFShift::classify_frequency_los(). LOS categories range F, representing highest level service (frequent buses) F representing lowest level service (least frequent buses). Note method adaptation original method, originally classifies LOS based headway (time) frequency (number buses per hour), last one proxy. title: Generate GTFS with OSM geometries
text: match GTFS shapes OSM routes geometries using either GTFShift::osm_shapes_match_routes() GTFShift::osm_shapes_to_routes() enables retrieval harmonized geometries GTFS network. However, OSM geometries often MULTILINESTRING objects. contrast, GTFS shapes.txt file requires sequence points define shape. GTFShift::create_shapes_from_sf() can used overcome limitation, encapsulating conversion MULTILINESTRING objects sorted LINESTRING objects generating corresponding GTFS shapes.txt structured table.
